exposure: Type of Cesarean section (planned vs. unplanned)
outcome: Frequency of immediate skin-to-skin contact after cesarean section
cohort: Women who gave birth by cesarean section between 16/11/17 and 28/11/17 in a level 3 hospital in France
finding: Immediate skin-to-skin contact after cesarean section was feasible, especially for planned cesarean sections, but less frequent for unplanned and emergency cesarean sections.
mod_finding: Immediate skin-to-skin contact was closely linked to the planned character of the cesarean section (89% vs. 31%, P = 0.005), as well as its color code (green 72%, orange 25%, red 0%).
